description:
I'm LumberjackSparrow, the creator of Ancient Warfare 2 Tweaked. I discovered this wonderful mod back in 2021, and immediately found issues I wanted to fix. Since AW2 was open source, I was able to fork it, and begin adding the fixes and config options I always wanted.

Since then, I have been an active member of the AW2 community, and contributed a few original structures, mainly for the previously unused Demon faction.

PRs, structure submissions, and requests are always welcome! Stop by the AW2 discord some time, it's a chill place.
